evidence.title: Overalls README
evidence.finding: Self-hosted platform for persistent Firecracker development machines (NixOS, Ubuntu, Windows) and the AI agents on them; built-in agent plus Codex and Claude Code pre-installed; browser, SSH, VS Code, overalls CLI and Mila app; research preview launching 12 November 2026; no hosted version; MIT.

evidence.title: Repository guidance
evidence.finding: Monorepo of Marshall control plane, Lilly provisioner and shared protocol; Buck2 builds; contributors use agents concurrently.

evidence.title: Porsche getting started
evidence.locator: Register your key; Connect; Install the Overalls CLI; First commands
evidence.finding: Email login, SSH key registration, Porsche SSH management commands new/ls/show/start/stop/relocate/pin, per-machine installer for Linux, macOS and Windows, 500 GiB disk cap.

evidence.title: Automation
evidence.finding: JSON output, request IDs for idempotent retries, wait timeouts of 120 seconds with --no-wait.

evidence.title: Public documentation index
evidence.finding: Browser extension, SSH guides, automation, reflection, notifications; llms.txt for language-model clients; Porsche provides no guest shell, file transfer or port forwarding.

evidence.title: Push notifications
evidence.finding: Content-free end-to-end encrypted push to Mila devices via the Susan relay for agent questions and plan proposals.

evidence.title: Architecture overview
evidence.finding: ADR-driven record: guest coding CLIs, memory-preserving suspension and demand wake, native Mila clients, with many ADRs marked accepted/partial; execution evidence and acceptance tracked separately.

evidence.title: Ziggy private inference
evidence.finding: Guests reach models only through Ziggy at llm.internal; Codex and Claude Code use native config with no OpenAI login or provider key in the guest; OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages supported; Marshall admission per request.

evidence.title: Underclass
evidence.finding: Operator-added Codex and Copilot accounts pooled behind a proxy with proxy-only credentials; quota and overload handling.

evidence.title: Ubuntu guests
evidence.finding: Ubuntu images install pinned Codex 0.149.0 and Claude Code 2.1.238 configured for Ziggy.

evidence.title: Guest OS matrix
evidence.finding: Seven OS families (NixOS, Ubuntu 26.04, Arch, Alma, FreeBSD 14.3, OmniOS, Windows Server 2025) each with recorded lifecycle evidence of differing scope.

evidence.title: Thread modes
evidence.finding: User-facing agent modes low, medium, high, ultra mapping to configured model and reasoning effort; default medium.

evidence.title: Agent tool protocol
evidence.finding: Built-in agent tools include spawn_child_agent ("start an independent child agent in this machine and wait for its result"), web_search and file reads.

evidence.title: Planning turns
evidence.finding: Planning turns with child agents returning findings, unresolved decisions and recommendations.

evidence.title: Plan proposals
evidence.finding: A completed planning response with a single implementation admission (human-approved plan).

evidence.title: Planning questions
evidence.finding: Durable human-answer barrier belonging to a root planning turn.

evidence.title: CLI access
evidence.finding: Browser-approved, short-lived (one hour) access for the user's overalls CLI; secret never visible to the browser.

evidence.title: Agents domain
evidence.finding: Durable VM-bound agent threads, turns, executor leases and audit receipts with paper-trail versions.

evidence.title: Threads domain
evidence.finding: User-facing conversations that own an automatically provisioned machine.

evidence.title: Thread grants
evidence.finding: Thread membership roles viewer, operator and manager retained with granting actor history.

evidence.title: Teams domain
evidence.finding: Shared machines and resources across accounts with owner/admin/member roles; SCIM-managed teams.

evidence.title: SCIM OIDC sign-in
evidence.finding: OIDC authorization-code sign-in for SCIM-provisioned identities with PKCE and ID-token verification; no automatic registration.

evidence.title: Machine sharing
evidence.finding: Transactional sharing, protected ownership and idempotent role replacement over Cedar policy.

evidence.title: Artifacts domain
evidence.finding: Agent-published, versioned pages shared through Cedar roles with immutable versions.

evidence.title: Message boards
evidence.finding: User and profile message boards with machine-scoped cleanup usable by agents and people.

evidence.title: GitHub integration
evidence.finding: Per-user GitHub OAuth custody with fenced admission; credentials injected at the edge and never in guests.

evidence.title: Integrations page
evidence.finding: UI text: connect GitHub for Git, pull requests, Actions and releases; credentials stay at the edge.

evidence.title: Inference usage export
evidence.finding: Owner usage CSV with request_id, vm_id, owner_id, provider, model, tokens and estimated_token_usd with pricing source/version.

evidence.title: Capacity budget
evidence.finding: Physical headroom less outstanding startup and relocation holds; missing usage withholds admission.

evidence.title: Notifications domain
evidence.finding: Content-free push for Mila devices produced after agent question and plan proposal commits; end-to-end encrypted pokes to Susan.

evidence.title: Editor domain
evidence.finding: Browser editor authority (VS Code) independent from ordinary web endpoint policy.

evidence.title: Terminal domain
evidence.finding: Durable terminal session registry with audit events for browser console access.

evidence.title: Lilly provisioner
evidence.finding: Lilly manages Firecracker microVMs, ZFS storage and guest networks on each execution host; running guests survive Lilly restarts.

evidence.title: Lyra and overalls CLI
evidence.finding: Rust package behind the overalls CLI configuring developer SSH access through Audi and submitting browser-approved agent prompts; also the in-guest tool executor.

evidence.title: Mila clients
evidence.finding: Native clients for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux as thin wrappers over a shared Rust core; Buck2 builds; release acceptance partial; no published releases.

evidence.title: Porsche SSH gateway
evidence.finding: Elixir SSH management gateway turning commands into authenticated Marshall API calls.

evidence.title: SCIM domain
evidence.finding: SCIM configuration and provisioning boundary with team retirement workers.

evidence.title: Security policy
evidence.finding: Private GitHub advisory or email with PGP key; no hosted service.

evidence.title: MIT licence
evidence.finding: MIT licence.

evidence.title: overalls.dev self-host guide
evidence.finding: Official site pages: self-hosting guide (provision, deploy, DNS, enroll, first machine, operations) and architecture; no screenshots of the product UI.

evidence.finding: No user-facing schedule, recurring agent run or inbound webhook; scheduling terms are internal Oban jobs and host maintenance.
